about.citat: "We opened Vibe Caffè because we believed a good coffee could change the tone of an entire day."
about.desc: At our café, every detail is crafted to offer more than a simple coffee — we offer a place where you can stop, breathe and enjoy the moment. We focus on taste, quality and atmosphere, so that every visit is a pleasant and memorable one.
about.val1Desc: Single-origin beans, roasted weekly. Every cup is a ritual prepared with precision and passion.
about.val2Desc: A place where people connect, work and relax together. More than just a café.
about.val3Desc: Compostable packaging, local suppliers and coffee with a positive impact on the environment.

rezervari.msg1Text: You chose Vibe Caffè for a special moment — and we will do everything possible to exceed every expectation. Our team will be ready for you.
rezervari.msg2Text: Trust us with this important moment. We will prepare everything with care and love, so your evening is exactly as you dreamed it.
rezervari.msg3Text: You chose the best way to start your day. We await you with freshly brewed coffee and an aroma that will lift your spirits from the very first sip.
rezervari.msg4Text: Midday is sweeter with a good coffee and a warm atmosphere. Out of hundreds of places, you chose to be with us — and that means everything.
rezervari.msg5Text: The afternoon is the perfect time for a specialty coffee and a lovely conversation. We await you with warmth and the best coffee in Crawley.
rezervari.msg6Text: Weekend evenings take on a different colour at Vibe Caffè. Relax, savour and let yourself be carried by our unique atmosphere.
rezervari.msg7Text: You chose to end the day with us — and we couldn't be happier. A good coffee and a welcoming space await you after a long day.
